question: Under what condition, even after being bitten by great serpents, is poison said not to enter the body?
premises: Poison is the subject in question.
Poison does not enter the body.
This holds even if one has been bitten.
The biting is by great serpents.
inference: Even if bitten by great serpents, poison does not enter the body.
uncertainties: Causal condition for this immunity not stated within the verse
plain_english: Poison does not enter the body, even if one has been bitten by great serpents.
